nodes.label: NeuroOne Design System
nodes.rationale: A living document capturing brand identity, color, typography and the login screen spec, to be extended as dashboard, case review and diagnosis output screens get designed.

nodes.label: Seira Wordmark
nodes.rationale: Used for the logotype only, never body copy or UI labels, because it is a display face not built for small sizes or long text. Free for personal/academic use; a commercial license from Ermedia Studio would be required if the project became commercial. Self-hosted rather than hotlinked.

nodes.label: Cormorant Garamond Fallback
nodes.rationale: Open-licensed with no restrictions, keeping the same elegant-serif character without a broken-font moment if Seira is not loaded.

nodes.label: Product Color Palette
nodes.rationale: A calm, light palette for anything a clinician actually works in: bg #EAF3FB, surface #FFFFFF, ink #0F2A43, ink-soft #4B6076, primary #2F6FA6.

nodes.label: Brand Color Palette
nodes.rationale: A richer palette reserved for auth/marketing moments, drawn from the same blue-violet-teal family as Product so the two tiers read as one identity: brand-navy #151B4D, brand-indigo #3D3AA8, brand-violet #6C4FE0, brand-teal #2FB6A3, brand-amber #F4C338 used sparingly.

nodes.label: Status Colors (status-watch, status-critical, status-stable)
nodes.rationale: Defined early because AI-01's contract already has confidence tiers and an early_watch category. status-watch #D98E04 reuses the brand-amber family so a flag visually ties back to the brand rather than looking like a generic warning color.

nodes.label: IBM Plex Sans UI Font
nodes.rationale: Chosen deliberately over a generic geometric sans because its engineered/data-sheet character reinforces that this is a technical diagnostic tool, and it holds up at small sizes in dense tables. Pairing an elegant serif wordmark against a precise technical interface font is intentional: classy brand mark, clinical product.

nodes.label: Login Screen Spec
nodes.rationale: Structure carried over from the reference design: left panel form, right panel decorative art, with a fixed element order. Only the skin changes. The decorative panel keeps the reference's color family but its stock shapes are to be replaced with neuro motifs so the panel looks like it belongs to this product, not a generic UI kit.
